issues.legal_issue: A concession agreement granting a right to collect tolls under a build-operate-transfer project constitutes a lease for purposes of the Transfer of Property Act and the Indian Stamp Act.
The 2002 amendment prescribing stamp duty for toll-collection concession agreements is not invalidated by legitimate expectation or promissory estoppel arising from prior executive assurances.
Stamp duty under the 2002 amendment is chargeable only on the amount spent by the lessee under the agreement, not on the entire project cost.
